summary.title: Redesigned Home layout with TIR banner
changes: Home header and panels were reorganized into a new glass-style layout with pump and loop panels.
A tappable Time‑in‑Range (TIR) stats banner was added under the adjustment panel and opens statistics when tapped.
The adjustments panel now shows remaining-time progress bars for overrides and temp targets, supports concurrent split‑.
bars, and the whole panel responds to full taps.
Meal row now shows an alarms pill that displays a snooze countdown and opens snooze controls when tapped.
